chapter_seo_title: Dao-Twisted World Ch. 487: Li Huowang Trades Life Pills for a Human Bone Relic
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang trades 400 Yang Life Pills for a Buddhist relic — a human finger bone. He feeds it to a blind Bai Lingmiao, who awakens a terrifying new vision.
og_description: A trade for a human bone, a curse planted in the tongue, and a wife who sees something she shouldn’t. Ch. 487 of Dao-Twisted World delivers quiet horror at every turn.
twitter_description: Li Huowang swaps 400 life pills for a human finger bone, feeds it to Bai Lingmiao, and she wakes up to a sight she never wanted. Body horror meets marital guilt.

lore_anchors.definition: Rainwater collected directly from the sky before it touches the ground; used in Daoist alchemy and TCM for its supposed purity.
A supernatural sense that allows perception of qi, auras, and hidden truths beyond physical sight; in this chapter, Bai Lingmiao attains it by consuming a relic.
A form of untainted lifespan energy that cannot be condensed into pills and must be personally conferred via a jade token.
The government body that polices supernatural activity in the Dao-Twisted World; its inner repository stores forbidden treasures, including relics and elixirs.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a Buddhist relic in this novel?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a crystallized human bone from an enlightened master, stored in nested pagodas. In the Dao-Twisted World, it is consumed to gain supernatural perception.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Bai Lingmiao suddenly see after eating the bone?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The relic grants a form of “mind-eye” — she can sense the qi and shape of objects and people, which functions like sight but without using her eyes.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang not tell her what she’s eating?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He knows she has deep trauma around human flesh and bones from Qingfeng Temple, so he withholds the truth to avoid refusal. It’s a morally gray survival decision.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What was the curse the Grand Preceptor put on Li Huowang?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A restriction planted in his tongue root that prevents him from speaking about certain topics; Li Huowang accepts it quietly because he never intended to talk anyway.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang’s qi look so unstable to Bai Lingmiao?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His existence is fragmented — flickering between worlds, carrying Danyangzi’s contamination and other influences. Her new perception may reveal his true, damaged state.
